text.title: C# Clean Architecture + CQRS Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure to scaffold a Clean Architecture + CQRS .NET solution end-to-end, from the layer graph to the fitness gate. Each step names the rules it satisfies.

step.name: scaffold-solution
step.action: Create 4 projects: `Domain` (classlib), `Application` (classlib), `Infrastructure` (classlib), `Api` (webapi). Add project references inward only, and pin the mediator + mapper majors in `Directory.Packages.props`, choosing the source-generated free options for a commercial product (`pin-bus-and-mapper-versions`).
step.decision-gate: If layered solution feels heavy for a CRUD app (<20 endpoints), STOP and apply `csharp-dotnet` umbrella instead. If Domain references EF Core or ASP.NET Core, FAIL and remove the reference before anything else.

step.name: model-domain
step.action: For each aggregate add an entity with `private set` only, a factory method, intention-revealing behaviour methods that enforce invariants, value objects, and domain events raised inside those methods (`rich-domain-no-setters`, `domain-events-raised-and-cleared`). Expose collections as `IReadOnlyCollection<T>`.
step.output: Domain project with aggregates and invariants
step.decision-gate: If domain ends up with only properties + getters, the methodology does not fit — apply `csharp-dotnet` umbrella.

step.name: add-application-use-cases
step.action: For each use-case create `Application/Features/<Feature>/<UseCase>/{Command|Query,Handler,Validator,Response}.cs`: the request is a `record : IRequest<TResponse>`, the handler is the only `IRequestHandler` for it and its `Handle` takes a `CancellationToken`, the validator is an `AbstractValidator<T>` registered via `AddValidatorsFromAssembly`, and the response is a record DTO not shared with any other query (`cqrs-record-request-per-handler`, `edge-validation` via `validators-on-commands`, `no-entity-in-api`). Domain rules stay in entity calls; expected failures return `Result`/`ErrorOr` rather than throwing (`result-for-expected-failures`). Register the pipeline behaviours in one explicit block: Logging → Validation → Authorization → UnitOfWork → Caching (`pipeline-behaviour-order`).
step.output: Application project with one folder per use-case
step.decision-gate: If a handler injects `DbContext`, reads `HttpContext`, or returns `IQueryable<T>`, refactor before adding the next use-case (`dbcontext-behind-interface`, `no-iqueryable-from-application`).

step.name: add-infrastructure
step.action: Implement the Application's repository interfaces and `IApplicationDbContext` with EF Core in Infrastructure (`dbcontext-behind-interface`). Configure entity mappings with `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>`. Add MassTransit Outbox for cross-aggregate events, publishing from the `SaveChangesAsync` override and clearing the aggregate's events afterwards. Verify the SQL generated for any `OwnsOne` value object — on EF Core 6/7 owned types double the JOINs and break `AsNoTracking` projections.
step.output: Infrastructure project with EF + Outbox wired
step.decision-gate: If any cross-aggregate event is dispatched without outbox, fail per `outbox-for-cross-aggregate` rule.

step.name: add-api-composition-root
step.action: Add controllers (or Minimal API endpoints) whose action body is a single `await _mediator.Send(req, ct)` and a return — no mapping, no auth checks, no header parsing. `Program.cs` is the only composition root and calls `AddApplication()` + `AddInfrastructure()` (`composition-root-per-layer`). Reserve the bus for use-cases with cross-cutting needs. Note that Minimal API + mediator loses the OpenAPI metadata controllers get for free.
step.output: Api project boots and serves endpoints
step.decision-gate: Reject the PR if a controller action holds any business logic; enforce a line-count budget on actions.

step.name: test-the-use-case
step.action: Write an xUnit handler test that mocks the repository and asserts the response, plus at least one `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` + Testcontainers integration test per feature (`integration-test-per-feature`). Assert the pipeline-behaviour order explicitly.
step.decision-gate: If the test asserts EF behaviour rather than handler logic, the handler is not isolated — refactor. If the only assertion is a mocked `IMediator.Send` call count, the test does not count.

step.name: enforce-arch-fitness
step.action: Add a NetArchTest project asserting: Domain has zero outward refs (no EF, no ASP.NET, no SDK); Application has no `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` and no `Microsoft.AspNetCore`; Infrastructure may reference Domain + Application. Add `templates/dotnet-cleanarch-lint.sh` as a pre-commit / MSBuild `BeforeTargets="Build"` gate for the grep-level checks NetArchTest cannot see (public setters, entities returned from controllers, commands without validators). Hook both into CI alongside `dotnet format --verify-no-changes`.
step.decision-gate: If NetArchTest fails, BLOCK merge — fix the leakage before any other change.
